content.title: Denny Hamlin
content.text: Hamlin roars back for emotional win in Las Vegas Denny Hamlin returned to Victory Lane at Las Vegas Motor Speedway on Sunday for the first time since he lost the NASCAR championship four months ago. about 10 days ago | Associated Press House fire that killed Hamlin's dad ruled accidental Investigators have ruled as accidental the North Carolina house fire in December that killed NASCAR driver Denny Hamlin's father and injured his mother, but the exact cause remains unclear. about 30 days ago | Associated Press JGR sues ex-director, alleges theft of trade secrets Joe Gibbs Racing filed suit against its former competition director for allegedly embarking on "a brazen scheme to steal JGR's most sensitive information." about 34 days ago | Associated Press Allgaier, Hamlin part of 20-car crash at Daytona A 20-car crash just past the midway point of the Daytona 500 on Sunday involved leader Justin Allgaier, three-time race winner Denny Hamlin and several other contenders. about 38 days ago | ESPN News Services Hamlin reinjured in fall searching fire wreckage Denny Hamlin says he plans to compete in the 2026 NASCAR season despite aggravating an existing shoulder injury in a fall while he was searching the damage from a house fire that killed his father. about 49 days ago | ESPN News Services Father of NASCAR's Hamlin dies after house fire Denny Hamlin's father died and his mother was critically injured after a weekend fire heavily damaged the North Carolina home where they lived. about 86 days ago | Associated Press
